annotations.title: Look up an HTS code and its duty rates

description: Looks up one HTS code (4, 6, 8 or 10 digits, with or without dots) in the current Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States and returns its description, parent hierarchy, general, special (trade program) and column 2 duty rates, units, footnotes, Chapter 99 cross-references and the lines below it.

detail.description: "summary" (default) shortens long texts and lists up to 25 lines below; "full" returns complete texts and up to 150 lines.

hts_code.description: HTS number with 4, 6, 8 or 10 digits, dotted or not, e.g. "8471.30.01", "847130", "6109.10.00.12".

name: hts_rate
